name: Engraver – Personalize and Customize WooCommerce Products
author: Digages

sections.description:
Engraver for WooCommerce makes it easy to sell personalized products from your WooCommerce store. Let customers add names, messages, logos, images, QR codes, and other customizations before placing an order.

Whether you sell engraved gifts, custom apparel, promotional products, phone cases, jewelry, awards, or print-on-demand products, Engraver provides everything you need to offer product personalization for your customers.

Unlock all features with Pro Version | Live Demo

Key Features

  • Template System: Create multiple engraving templates and apply them to individual products, categories, or your entire WooCommerce store.
  • Multiple Engraving Sides: Let customers personalize the front, back, edge, or any custom side of a product.
  • Custom Text: Allow customers to add names, messages, initials, long messages, QR codes, and other personalized content.
  • Image Uploads [PRO]: Let customers upload logos, artwork, signatures, or photos for product customization.
  • Included with Product: Bundle engraving and personalization into your product at no additional cost.
  • Charge for Personalization [PRO]: Add optional fees for engraving, custom text, image uploads, QR codes, and more.
  • Engraving Orders Dashboard: Manage all personalized orders from one place with engraving details included in WooCommerce orders.
  • WooCommerce Integration: Built natively for WooCommerce with zero setup. Works seamlessly with your existing products, checkout, and order management.
  • Engraving Status Tracking: Track engraving progress with statuses like Pending, and Done.
  • Fulfillment Ready: View structured engraving details, copy customer text, and download uploaded files directly from the order.
  • Unlimited Templates [PRO]: Create and manage unlimited engraving templates for different products and categories.
  • Bulk Template Assignment [PRO]: Apply engraving templates to multiple products or categories with a single click.
  • Premium Support [PRO]: Create support tickets and get fast, prioritized assistance whenever you need help.

Perfect For

Whether you sell personalized gifts, engraved products, or custom merchandise, Engraver helps you offer product personalization directly from your WooCommerce store.

  • Gift Shops: Personalize gifts with names, messages, dates, and special occasions.
  • Jewelry Stores: Offer custom engraving for rings, necklaces, bracelets, watches, and more.
  • Print-on-Demand Stores: Let customers personalize apparel, mugs, tumblers, and other custom products.
  • Trophy & Award Shops: Add recipient names, award titles, and custom messages.
  • Phone Case & Accessory Stores: Personalize phone cases, laptop sleeves, and accessories with text and QR codes.
  • Laser Engraving Businesses: Collect engraving requests with structured personalization details.
  • Corporate & Promotional Products: Customize branded merchandise with company names, employee names, or logos.
  • Handmade & Craft Stores: Sell personalized handmade products without manual order collection.
  • Holiday & Seasonal Stores: Create custom products for birthdays, weddings, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, and other special occasions.
  • WooCommerce Stores: Add product personalization to any WooCommerce store without custom development.

sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard:

  • Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New Plugin from the left-hand menu.
  • In the search box, type Engraver by Digages.
  • Click on Install Now when you see Engraver – Personalize and Customize WooCommerce Products.
  • After installation, click Activate.
sections.faq:
Does Engraver for WooCommerce work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. Engraver works with most WooCommerce-compatible themes and integrates directly into your product pages without requiring any additional setup.

How do I set up the plugin?

Getting started is quick and simple. Install the plugin, create an engraving template, and assign it to your WooCommerce products. Follow our complete setup guide

Do I need technical knowledge to set it up?

No. Engraver is built to work out of the box with WooCommerce, so you can start offering personalized products without any coding or technical knowledge.

Can I charge customers for engraving?

Yes. You can include engraving in your product price or, with the PRO version, charge additional fees based on the type of customization, such as text, image uploads, or QR codes.

Can customers engrave multiple parts of a product?

Yes. You can allow customers to personalize multiple sides of a product, including the front, back, edge, or any custom side you define.

Where can I see engraving details after an order is placed?

All engraving details are available in WooCommerce orders page, order emails, and the Engraving Orders dashboard, where you can easily copy customer text and download uploaded files.

What’s the difference between engraving, personalization, and customization?

They all refer to allowing customers to modify a product before purchasing. “Engraving” is commonly used for jewelry and engraved products, “personalization” is popular for gifts, while “customization” is a broader term that includes text, images, logos, QR codes, and other design options.

What’s the difference between the Free and PRO versions?

The free version includes the core personalization features, including engraving templates, custom text, QR codes, multiple engraving sides, fulfillment management, and WooCommerce integration.

The PRO version unlocks image uploads, paid personalization, unlimited templates, bulk template assignment, and premium support.

How can I upgrade to PRO?

You can purchase a PRO license from the Engraver website
